# FDG6002

> CONSIDER using protected members for advanced customization.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 6.1.2 Protected Members.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application none, test none
- Status: draft

Library only: the customization is for users who derive from the class outside the library. Not an analyzer candidate: a design option.

## From the book

Protected members are a great way to provide advanced customization without complicating the public interface.
